subject: rt-dy
title: RT.DY.------TR.
description: Chart on book p. 220 (WAC-18). RT-DY (reality dynamics) is the subject; TR (transformation) is the partner. From the subject: OP-SPD (option spread), ALT-F (alternative functionalism) and UNI-PI. From OP-SPD: PROG-EXT-FT (progressional extended functionalism). From ALT-F: RE-ST (restructuralism). From UNI-PI: C-INFO (composite information) and PROG-CONT (progressional continuance). From C-INFO: AF-CON (affinity convergence). From AF-CON: ACC-DY (accelerated dynamics). From PROG-CONT: IST-F (isolated focus). From IST-F: MT-INFO (multi-information).
